sights.w: Free 15,000 sq ft heritage center ('life's journey') telling Stoughton's Norwegian immigration story — a 33-screen interactive wall to build an emigrant's profile, plus a genealogy center.

sights.n: Indian Lake County Park & St. Mary of the Oaks Chapel
sights.address: WI Hwy 19, 2 mi west of US 12, Town of Berry (near Cross Plains), WI
sights.w: 791-acre county park around a kettle lake, crossed by the Ice Age Trail; a half-mile climb leads to the tiny 1857 hilltop chapel the Endres family built after surviving diphtheria.

sights.address: 3101 Lake Farm Rd, Madison (Fitchburg line), WI 53711
sights.w: Wisconsin's first urban state recreation area — Lake Waubesa shoreline, the Lussier family heritage area and the Lake Farm archaeological trail, joined to Dane County's Lunney Lake Farm park.

sights.address: Quarry Ridge Recreation Area, 2740 Fitchrona Rd, Fitchburg, WI 53719
sights.w: 40-mile rail-trail along the old Military Ridge road to Dodgeville; the paved Fitchburg–Verona end is the easy Madison-area ride, with Driftless hills further west.
